_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: Send food to the kitchen from Go at a venue whose kitchen station is set to Printer: Save Table or Pay. The ticket should print on the till's kitchen printer within a few seconds, marked Vesopa Go. Needs the till on the matching update. Also: on a phone, page keys sit together at the top with each page's products underneath.
release_notes: Orders from Go now print on the till's kitchen printer. On a phone, the page buttons sit together at the top.
